recipe.title: Almond Flour
recipe.description: Learn how to make almond flour at home! Then, use it in pancakes, waffles, muffins, cookies, and more.
instructions: Blend the almonds in a high speed blender until they become a fine meal, about 10 seconds, depending on your blender.
Stir to loosen any large clumps or almond pieces near the base of the blender. Don't over-blend or your almonds will start turning into almond butter.
Use in any recipe that calls for almond flour or almond meal.
